name: mnote_list_categories
description: List the account's categories — the color-coded tags used to organize notes (there are no folders). Returns an array, each with: id (used to tag notes in mnote_create_note / mnote_update_note and to filter mnote_list_notes), name, color (a hex), created_at. A user has at most 12 categories; the defaults are home, work, and personal.
